interpretation: The entry: Baker (1998) reads the private-language sections as showing not that the notion is intelligible but false, 'but rather that it is nonsense masquerading as an important possibility', in line with resolute readings (§1.1). Attribution reading of the position the entry reports, not a view of the entry's author.
attribution: The passage states that Baker reads the private-language sections as showing that a private language is nonsense masquerading as a possibility rather than an intelligible falsehood, which is the premise.
